integrity: All algebraic claims proved in RESULT.md; check_seedbank.py supplies exact-rational and symbolic supplemental tests. Earlier seed-bank identifiability is explicitly credited. Historical novelty is provisional, and no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Structural, population-law identification for the precisely specified homogeneous one-year seed-bank process with perfect detection and strictly interior probabilities; no guarantees for finite realized surveys, heterogeneous patches, imperfect detection, multiyear dormancy, or external validation.
title: Three annual censuses sharply identify a one-year seed-bank occupancy model
